description: Bulk import contacts. Returns an import job record; poll status via `get-contact-import`.

contacts.description: Contacts to import. Each entry needs at least an `email`; optionally include custom `fields`, `list_ids_included`, and `list_ids_excluded`.

fields.description: Custom field values keyed by merge tag. Values may be string or number.

list_ids_excluded.description: Contact list IDs to remove this contact from.

list_ids_included.description: Contact list IDs to add this contact to.

name: create-contact-import
